REDS WERE LYING ABOUT THEIR OWN CAUSE — fixed. Checking two reds that claimed capabilities I had already shipped, I found both were quoting STALE errors: BEB-2412's red said "no SPEC.md" while its actual latest attempt (17:23) was the m2535 mock guard; BEB-2526's said "shape 'pwa' has no template path" while its latest (18:11) was "no SPEC.md" — hours after the pwa template shipped. ROOT CAUSE, one word: the detector used MAX(error), which is the LEXICOGRAPHIC max of the error string, plus MAX(ticket) — so every REPEAT_FAILER/SILENT_REFUSAL red cited whichever text sorted highest in the 24h window, not what actually happened last. That is how a fixed cause keeps reading as current and sends whoever reads the bridge chasing solved problems (it sent me chasing one an hour ago). FIXED (dispatcher 0367ef0): reds now take error+ticket from the MAX(at) row and label it "LATEST (timestamp)". Also: 2526 spec authored (doc bfa6667a) + evidence comment + requeued. Standing implication for the wall register — a red's TEXT is evidence and must carry the same provenance discipline as everything else; "an arbitrary sample from a window" is not a diagnosis.
